signature.name: VTask.IsHomeomorphicTrivialFiberBundle
signature.type: {B : Type u_1} -> (F : Type u_2) -> {Z : Type u_3} -> [TopologicalSpace B] -> [TopologicalSpace F] -> [TopologicalSpace Z] -> (proj : Z → B) -> Prop

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: This is a Prop-valued predicate that is simply false when the trivialisation homeomorphism does not exist; no junk-value or edge convention is needed.

facts.statement: ∀ {B F Z : Type*} [TopologicalSpace B] [TopologicalSpace F] [TopologicalSpace Z] (proj : Z → B), VTask.IsHomeomorphicTrivialFiberBundle F proj → ∃ e : Z ≃ₜ B × F, proj = Prod.fst ∘ e
